title: pdfcn
brief: A collection of beautifully designed, accessible and customizable PDF components built on Takumi. Handy if you ever need to render polished PDFs from a web stack.
details: pdfcn (pdfcn.dev) — "beautiful PDFs, made simple." Ready-to-use, customizable PDF components for React (e.g. corporate-invoice templates), built on Takumi and Forme and distributed via shadcn (`pnpm dlx shadcn add @pdfcn/forme/alert`). The pitch is bringing the shadcn-style copy-paste component experience to PDF generation in React apps — invoices, reports, and documents that look designed rather than default. Includes a theme builder for customization.
